task: Generate one photorealistic reference photo of a single skincare product, front view, to be used as the exact visual reference of this product in every later image. The product must match "product" exactly; the label must be perfectly legible and correctly spelled.

output.look: clean, realistic product reference photo taken with a phone, true-to-life colors

product.name: ALBA vitamin C face serum (a fictional brand)
product.bottle: a small 30 ml amber-brown glass Boston round dropper bottle with rounded shoulders, about 9 cm tall including the dropper (roughly the length of an adult index finger), smooth glass with subtle real reflections
product.dropper: a glossy black rubber bulb on top of a black ribbed plastic screw collar; when the dropper is out, a clear glass pipette with a narrow tip
product.label: a matte cream paper label (#F4EDE2) wrapped around the middle of the bottle, covering about half of its height, with a thin solid orange band (#F28C28) along its bottom edge; flat, clean print, no gloss
product.label_text: exactly two centered lines and nothing else: 'ALBA' in large bold dark-brown sans-serif capital letters, and below it 'VITAMINA C' in smaller dark-brown sans-serif capital letters; no other words, numbers, icons or symbols
product.serum: a clear, slightly golden, light and fluid liquid
product.rule: the product must look exactly like this in every image: same shape, proportions, colors, materials, label design and label text

composition.view: straight front view at the bottle's mid-height, the label facing the camera and centered, the dropper cap on
composition.framing: the whole bottle in frame, centered, filling about 60% of the image height, with even space around it
composition.surface: standing upright on a plain light warm-gray matte surface, a soft natural contact shadow under it
composition.background: plain light warm-gray seamless background, nothing else in the image

lighting.key: soft, even, diffused daylight from the front, like a window behind the camera
lighting.mood: neutral and accurate colors, low contrast, a soft natural highlight on the glass, no harsh reflections over the label

realism_rules: real amber glass with true transparency and subtle reflections
real paper label texture, perfectly flat print, crisp letters
correct proportions, perfectly upright, no distortion
negative: any text other than 'ALBA' and 'VITAMINA C' on the label, misspelled letters, extra lines of small text, numbers, icons, barcodes
a second bottle, props, hands, people, flowers, water splashes, decorations
a different bottle shape, a frosted or clear bottle, a pump or spray cap, a gold or white cap
3D render, CGI, illustration, heavy studio advertising look, dramatic lighting, reflections covering the label
